name: Elliot Ardia
source:
A young woman who recently discovered her witchling abilities. She was one of Lana's first customers when the bakery opened up and is Lana's self-proclaimed biggest fan.

She enjoys eating sweets, talking about town gossip and cracking the odd joke here and there. She can be forgetful at times and is a bit of a clutz.

[From [url=https://www.witpopgames.com/bakedmagic.html]official website[/url]]
